trust_decision.summary: The ISUP decoder uses the attacker-controlled parameter length byte from a SIP application/isup body to decide how many BCD digits it writes into a fixed 26-byte static buffer and how far it reads the packet. Neither count is checked against the buffer size or the body length in the six isup_get_*number decoders.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names ss7_parser.c isup_get_calling_party, and its digit loop at :301-311 is the obvious overflow.

fix_sites.entry_point: $sipt(called_party_number) (src/modules/sipt/sipt.c:760); mandatory fixed param, different base offset
caller-side buffer size 26 replaced by MAX_SB_BUF_LEN in the six sipt_get_*number PV getters (fix.diff:13-77)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All published sites are in src/modules/sipt/ss7_parser.c plus the matching buffer declarations in src/modules/sipt/sipt.c. No second implementation, lower-level API or wrapper exists elsewhere: the only ISUP users in src/ are sipt and the core content-type table (src/core/parser/parse_content.c:212).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: get_optional_header and the isup_update_* encoders are 'not the digit decoders' and only overread by a byte or feed lengths to lumps, so a solver can argue they are a different (read-only/mangling) issue from the reported write overflow into sb_buf.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Valid odd-length numbers skip the high filler nibble of the last octet, and the PV must still return the full number. A fix that rejects every parameter longer than the buffer or every odd/short length (sbparamlen<=1), or that makes get_optional_header strict, would break normal $sipt reads and sipt_set_calling/sipt_forwarding header rewriting.

O6_input_shapes: optional-parameter TLV digits starting at offset+4 (calling/redirection/redirecting/original_called)
generic number with an extra qualifier octet, digits at offset+5 and oddeven at offset+3 (src/modules/sipt/ss7_parser.c:583-589)
mandatory fixed called_party_number located via the IAM fixed header rather than get_optional_header (src/modules/sipt/ss7_parser.c:369-382)
redirection number with no odd/even handling, always writes two nibbles (src/modules/sipt/ss7_parser.c:453-457)
length byte too large for the buffer (write overflow) vs. length byte past body end (read overflow) vs. length < 2 (negative sbparamlen)

O7_producer.where: src/modules/sipt/ss7_parser.c:178-230 get_optional_header: a shared TLV walker that produces the offset every decoder trusts. It reads optparm->len (offset+1) with only len>0 checked at :216-220.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Shared optional-parameter walker reads the length byte at offset+1 when only one byte remains, so it can read one byte past the body; the published fix leaves it unchanged.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a 1-byte over-read in a helper the advisory never names; the reported bug is a write into sb_buf.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~70 lines above the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: isup_get_redirection_info checks only len-offset>1 and then reads buf[offset+2], for both the generic-notification and diversion parameters (off-by-one over-read).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is an integer getter with no output buffer, so a solver focused on 'buffer overflow into sb_buf' skips it.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: isup_update_calling/isup_update_forwarding walk optional params and call replace_body_segment with the attacker length buf[offset+1]+1, not checked against len. The callers also override body.len with the remainder of the whole SIP message (sipt.c:1017, :1083) rather than the ISUP part length.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These are encoder/mangling routes (sipt_set_calling, sipt_forwarding config functions), a 'neighbouring feature' rather than the $sipt decoders in the report.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file plus caller in src/modules/sipt/sipt.c:1017

O8_uncovered_routes.route: isup_update_destination takes res=buf[offset]+1 for the called-party param, and the delete length res+1, without bounding them by len before replace_body_segment.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The destination rewrite is a legacy outbound-mangling path, and the length later fails the len<1 check anyway (but only after the lump has been queued).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A generic-number qualifier or location-number decoder that copies digits with its own base offset (+5/+6) and the same sbparamlen arithmetic.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The module already has six copy-pasted decoders with differing base offsets, and ISUP has more address parameters (location number, connected number) that a maintainer could add the same way.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A body-length producer that differs from the one the getters use (whole-message remainder vs. get_body_part part length), feeding the decoders a larger len.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The update functions already do this override, so moving it into a shared sipt_check_IAM-like helper is a plausible refactor and creates a HOW-type producer the check never sees.

O9_family: memory safety: stack/static buffer write overflow and out-of-bounds read in a binary TLV decoder (CWE-119/120)

O10_build.toolchain: make or CMake with gcc/clang; module src/modules/sipt has no external library deps (src/modules/sipt/Makefile)
O10_build.project_tests: None for sipt. misc/fuzz has libFuzzer targets for core parsers (e.g. misc/fuzz/fuzz_parse_msg.c) but no sipt target. ss7_parser.c only depends on ss7.h/sdp_mangle, so getter-level tests can link the decoder directly.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Bound sb_i against 26 inside isup_get_calling_party only (or only enlarge its buffer), leaving the other five decoders, the packet-length over-read and the shared get_optional_header walk unchanged.

out_of_scope_notes: sipt.c sipt_destination2/sipt_forwarding allocate digits with calloc and never check for NULL (src/modules/sipt/sipt.c:961, :1097).
The published called_party check mixes coordinates: offset is relative to called_party_number and len is reduced by offsetof (src/modules/sipt/ss7_parser.c:361, :369; fix.diff:145, :158).
unverified: Whether core del_lump/anchor_lump2 bound offset+len against msg->len, which decides whether the O8 update-function routes are exploitable or only lead to wrong mangling (src/modules/sipt/sdp_mangle.c:33).
present_in_latest for all O8 routes: no latest release was provided.
Recall risk is estimated; no external write-ups were checked.
